reasons.plausibility: The proposed selective oxidation of Al and Cr to form a protective oxide scale aligns well with established oxidation mechanisms and known diffusion behaviors in multi-component alloys.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison between Al/Cr-enriched and Mn-rich alloys under well-defined oxidation conditions, combined with mass gain and microstructural analyses, provides a definitive way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly addresses how to achieve and confirm protective oxide formation in high-temperature HEAs, making it highly pertinent for guiding alloy design and research on oxidation resistance.
